nodes.label: laptop memory - dispatch agents in the background

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Dispatch every agent or worker with run_in_background true and let the completion notification bring the result; never run an agent in the foreground, because a synchronous run freezes the conversation until the agent finishes. The user cannot talk during one and experiences it as the assistant hijacking the conversation with infinitywork and taking actually forever. Fire the worker in the background, say in one short line what it is doing, keep the conversation responsive, and keep the volume down - do not chain multiple agents for small asks. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.9 verdict: GROUNDED (07-29 22:48), noting it sits in tension with the never-bury-runs-in-background rule, where the real distinction is agents background, runs foreground in the user's terminal
